title: Ductile Design and Detailing of Reinforced Concrete Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces

clauses.title: Minimum Grade of Concrete in Seismic Zones
clauses.text: Minimum grade of structural concrete shall be M20, but M25 for buildings: a) more than 15 m in height in Seismic Zones III, IV and V; and b) but not less than that required by IS 456 based on exposure conditions.

clauses.title: Steel Reinforcement Requirements for Ductility
clauses.text: High strength deformed steel bars conforming to IS 1786 of grade Fe 415 or Fe 500 shall be used. Steel shall have minimum elongation of 14.5 percent and ratio of actual ultimate tensile strength to actual yield strength not less than 1.15.

clauses.title: Geometric Constraints for Seismic Beams
clauses.text: The width-to-depth ratio of flexural members shall be at least 0.3 (b/D >= 0.3). Width of member shall not be less than 200 mm. Depth D of member shall not exceed 1/4 of clear span.

clauses.title: Longitudinal Reinforcement in Beams
clauses.text: At least two bars of 12 mm diameter shall be provided continuously along both the top and bottom faces throughout the length of the beam.

clauses.title: Minimum Tension Steel in Seismic Beams
clauses.text: The minimum area of tension reinforcement on any face at any section shall be: rho_min = (0.24 * sqrt(fck)) / fy. The maximum area of reinforcement shall not exceed 2.5 percent of cross-sectional area (rho_max = 0.025).

clauses.title: Moment Capacity at Beam-Column Joint Face
clauses.text: The positive moment capacity at joint face shall not be less than 50 percent of the negative moment capacity at that face (Mu+ >= 0.5 * Mu-). Neither positive nor negative moment resistance at any section along length shall be less than 1/4 of the maximum moment capacity at either joint face.

clauses.title: Seismic Confinement Stirrups and Hooks
clauses.text: Web reinforcement in beams shall consist of closed hoops. Hoops shall have 135-degree hooks with a 10-diameter extension (but not less than 65 mm) embedded into the core concrete.

clauses.title: Closely Spaced Confining Stirrups in Beams (Plastic Hinge Zone)
clauses.text: Over a length 2d from the face of each joint, hoop spacing shall not exceed: a) d/4; b) 8 times diameter of smallest longitudinal bar; and c) 100 mm. The first hoop shall be at not more than 50 mm from joint face.

clauses.title: Minimum Dimensions of Seismic Columns
clauses.text: The minimum cross-sectional dimension of a column shall not be less than 300 mm, nor less than 20 times the diameter of the largest longitudinal reinforcement bar in beam framing into it.

clauses.title: Special Confining Reinforcement Length in Columns
clauses.text: Special confining reinforcement shall be provided over length lo from each joint face: a) larger lateral dimension of column; b) 1/6 of clear span of column; and c) 450 mm.

clauses.title: Pitch of Special Confining Ties in Columns
clauses.text: Pitch of special confining ties along length lo shall not exceed: a) 1/4 of minimum column dimension; b) 6 times diameter of smallest longitudinal bar; and c) 100 mm.
